name: Facet
text: Make the timeline a fixed-height strip at the top, always visible, with a subtle glow behind new events. It keeps the screen’s attention on the live data without scrolling or resizing the main view. Trade-off: we lose some vertical space for content, but the timeline’s constant presence outweighs that—users won’t miss updates.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip still buries critical decisions under noise if events arrive faster than users can parse them. The glow risks becoming background wallpaper, not an alert. Settle it with a live test: measure how often users miss key events in a simulated high-volume stream.
